# Yishog Integrated Services Limited — Full Site Content

> Industrial transmission and conveyor belt solutions for Nigeria and West Africa

## Company Overview

Yishog Integrated Services Limited is a specialist industrial distributor headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. Founded over 15 years ago, the company supplies precision transmission belts, conveyor systems, vee belts, industrial hoses and Habasit flat belts to manufacturers across 12 industrial sectors in Nigeria and West Africa.

**Contact:**
- Address: 17B Debo-Aina Crescent, Off Adeyemo Akapo Street, Omole Phase 1, Ojodu-Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria
- Phone: +234 809 199 9991 / +234 802 304 7845
- Email: sale@yishog.com / hello@YishogIntegrated.com
- Business Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00am–5:00pm, Saturday 9:00am–2:00pm, Sunday closed

## Products

### Timing Belts
Synchronous power transmission belts for precise speed control. Available in imperial pitch profiles (MXL 0.080", XL 0.200", L 0.375", H 0.500", XH 0.875", XXH 1.250") and metric HTD/GT profiles (3M, 5M, 8M, 14M, 20M). Neoprene rubber body with fibreglass tensile cord. Operating temperature -30°C to +100°C. Available as endless belts and open-end stock.

### Toothed Belts
Positive-drive belts for zero-slip synchronous applications. Available in neoprene (standard) and polyurethane (PU) constructions. PU belts offer superior oil/chemical resistance and can be field-welded. Profiles: AT, T, HTD, GT2/GT3.

### Conveyor Belts
Flat conveyor belts in rubber, PVC and PU compounds — general purpose, oil-resistant, heat-resistant and FDA food-grade grades. Cleated and chevron-profile belts for inclined conveying up to 35–40°. Cover grades: EP, NN, AA, AB, BB, CC. Custom widths and lengths available.

### Double Sided Timing Belts
Twin-power belts with synchronous teeth on both inner and outer faces. Enable serpentine and counter-rotation drives from a single belt. Profiles: XL, L, H, XH, HTD 5M, 8M, 14M. Applications: printing, weaving, multi-spindle machines.

### Transmission Belts
Flat transmission belts (leather, rubber, PVC, polyamide) for high-speed long-centre drives. Wedge belts (3V, 5V, 8V) for compact high-torque drives. Multi-rib Poly-V (PK section) for engine auxiliaries and industrial equipment.

### Vee Belts
Classical V-belts in A, B, C, D, E sections to ISO 22 / DIN 2215. Wrapped (standard) and raw-edge options. Cogged raw-edge for small-pulley applications. Matched sets for multi-belt drives. Applications: agricultural, HVAC, industrial.

### Modular Plastic Chain Belts
Interlocking polypropylene, acetal (POM) and polyethylene modules. FDA and EU food-contact compliant materials available. Flat-top and open-grid (10–55% open area) versions. Suitable for wash-down environments. Easy single-module replacement. Applications: food, beverage, packaging, washing.

### Stainless Steel Belts
Solid SS304/SS316/SS316L belts (0.3mm–2.0mm thickness, up to 2,000mm width) for high-temperature processing up to 600°C and precision laminating. Stainless steel mesh belts (woven and welded, aperture 1mm–50mm+) for food, glass annealing and electronics. Both hygienic non-contaminating surfaces.

### Mesh Belts
Balanced spiral mesh (alternating left/right coils with straight cross-rods) — carbon steel, stainless steel, galvanised; widths up to 4,000mm. Compound balanced mesh (finer, denser) for smaller products. Applications: baking, drying, cooling, washing conveyors.

### Balance Belts
Symmetric spiral-link metal mesh belts with crimped cross-rods for dimensional stability and zero tracking drift. Materials: carbon steel, SS304, SS316. Applications: wire processing, textile, filtration.

### Hoses
**Steam hoses:** EPDM inner tube, 2–4 wire braid, working pressure up to 18 bar, temperature range -40°C to +210°C, EN ISO 6134 Type 2.
**Air hoses:** NBR inner tube, textile or wire braid, working pressure 10–40 bar, temperature -20°C to +80°C, EN 559 / ISO 2398.
**Pressure hoses:** 1-wire, 2-wire, 4-wire braid and 4/6-spiral wound; working pressure 100–700+ bar; SAE 100R / EN 853 / EN 856; for hydraulic oil, water and mild chemicals.

### Habasit Hot Press Belts
Habasit polyamide and polyester flat belts — plain, friction, perforated and anti-static surfaces; operating speeds up to 100 m/s; low elongation for precise positioning; field-joinable.
Hot press belts for short-cycle laminating, through-feed pressing and veneer pressing: temperature resistance up to 220°C continuous, pressure up to 40 N/mm², release coating, joining methods (Clipper, steel-cord, endless weld). Applications: MDF laminating, veneer pressing, HPL (High Pressure Laminates). Yishog is an authorised Habasit distributor in Nigeria.
